Messages.Author: Henrik Isaksson
Messages.Body:
If a merged vampire is burned, can it then be possessed (or deamonic posssesed)? If so, do one get
the merged vampire or one of the base or the advanced? Can one choose which?

--
/Henrik Isaksson

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Henrik Isaksson wrote:
> If a merged vampire is burned, can it then be possessed (or deamonic posssesed)? If so, do one get
> the merged vampire or one of the base or the advanced? Can one choose which?

The vampire can be retrieved.
You can retrieve either the base or the advanced.
The merged version doesn't exist in the ash heap, so cannot be retrieved.

--

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. Possession offers no merge capability.

The only card that offers a merge capability is Gift of Experience.
Barring card text that effects a merge (like GoE), the only way to merge is
as defined in the rules.



Messages.Author: Matthew T. Morgan
Messages.Body:



I think that would violate the rule about self-contesting. Just like I
couldn't have The Baron I control attempt to Possess a burned The Baron
from my ash heap (or Daemonically Possess it from someone else's).
Remember, a base version of a vampire contests with the advanced (or
merged) versions as though they were the same vampire.

Also, no reason it would merge. LSJ already covered that.

Matt Morgan
